steps.text: Four friends order one pizza. It is cut into 8 equal slices. Rani wants to know how much each friend gets.
If 4 friends share 8 slices equally, how many slices does each friend get?
Yes! 8 shared by 4 is 2. Each friend gets 2 slices. Two slices out of eight is the same as one quarter of the pizza.
Let us share again. 8 slices, 4 friends: 8 shared by 4 is 2. Each friend gets 2 slices, which is one quarter of the pizza.
Well done! Eight slices shared by four friends means two each, and two out of eight is one quarter.
